items.claim: Uros Medic has a vulnerability to being dropped or caught on the chin based on past fights.
items.quote: This was a guy who got dropped by Gilbert Erbina. This guy got dropped by Matt Semllesburgger. This guy got dropped by Puna Heliano.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is returning to fight at the age of 43.
items.quote: the return of Yan Bohovich at the ripe age of 43.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is taking the fight on short notice as a replacement.
items.quote: Navajo Sterling, who is taking this fight on, I guess somewhat of short notice.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling has shown a recent ability to secure finishes and knock guys out.
items.quote: he's finally starting to knock guys out.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling is vulnerable to being taken down by opponents.
items.quote: We've seen this guy taken down in the past. We saw Ewan Cout Lava take him down a bunch.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has fought a higher caliber of competition, including champions and Magomed Ankalaev, over the last couple of years.
items.quote: You look at the guys that Yonhovich has fought over the last couple of years. He's fighting champions. He's fighting Magamed Ankollay.
